title: 第十九章 需要帮我一个忙第二十章 真想假戏真做了
content_zh:
“喂，社长？”
李梦瑶刚走不久，陆原又接到了一个电话，白染打来的。
陆原知道，白染打来的电话，基本上没别的事，百分之八十是让自己去捡网球，百分之二十是让自己去搬东西出苦力。
“哪个网球场？”不等白染开口，陆原干脆直接开门见山的问道。
其实，陆原也不怎么想去。
不过，突然想到了风聆，也许能见到风聆呢？
“你还真是够吊丝的，思维都这么吊丝。”白染的语气里透露着浓厚的鄙夷，“好了，今天不是喊你捡球的，来上岛咖啡厅。”
上岛咖啡厅？
陆原愣了，这简直有点匪夷所思了，白染竟然会让自己去咖啡厅。
“限你十分钟之内赶紧到！”
啪，白染电话挂了。
对陆原，白染都是这样的语气，命令的语气，也许在她的心里，根本没有平衡看待过陆原，一直把陆原当成是一个呼之即来的奴才一样的人吧。
当然去了。
陆原心里也有点好奇。
上岛咖啡厅在金陵大学外面的一条叫做光谷步行街上，这条步行街档次还是挺高的，衣服品牌一般都在千元价位以上。
“这边！”
陆原刚进咖啡厅，白染就向他招手。
看来白染早就到了，就坐在咖啡厅的一株绿植旁边。
今天白染穿着的很漂亮，白裙子，泡沫鞋，空气刘海，长发光泽柔滑，白玉一般的手腕上，还戴着配饰，正喝着咖啡。
“就你一个人？风聆没来吗？”

陆原心里很好奇，白染一个人，还把自己约在了咖啡厅，这是什么情况？
“告诉你陆原，别打风聆的主意！”白染似乎很恼火，“怎么的，是不是上次你看到风聆帮你包扎伤口，你觉得她对你有意思啊？别痴心妄想了，风聆性格就是善良那种的，对谁都这样，再说了，你配的上她吗？有点自知之明好不好？”
“好吧。”
陆原也不跟她争辩。
服务员走了过来：“先生，你需要点些什么？”
“这个，有菜单吗？”陆原刚开口。
白染在那边就嗤笑着对服务员道：“你问他没用，他都没来过这种地方，你就给他来一杯椰香咖啡吧。”
说实话，陆原也是习惯了白染这种态度，毕竟之前在网球社，白染就这么一直看不起自己。
所以，陆原也不怎么在乎白染的态度。
只是，心里愈发奇怪，白染找自己到底是要干嘛？
而白染显然，也没打算急着告诉陆原。
content_en:
"Hello, President?"
Not long after Li Mengyao left, Lu Yuan received another call, from Bai Ran.
Lu Yuan knew that the calls from Bai Ran were basically for nothing else. Eighty percent of them were asking him to pick up tennis balls, and twenty percent were asking him to do some hard work moving things.
"Which tennis court?" Before Bai Ran could say anything, Lu Yuan asked straight to the point.
In fact, Lu Yuan didn't really want to go.
However, I suddenly thought of Feng Ling. Maybe I could see Feng Ling?
"You are really careless, and your thinking is so careless." Bai Ran's tone revealed a strong disdain, "Okay, I'm not asking you to pick up the ball today, come to Shangdao Cafe."
Shangdao Cafe?
Lu Yuan was stunned. It was a bit unbelievable that Bai Ran would let him go to the coffee shop.
"You have to be here within ten minutes!"
Bang, Bai Ran hung up the phone.
Both Lu Yuan and Bai Ran had this kind of tone, a commanding tone. Maybe in her heart, she had never viewed Lu Yuan in a balanced way, and she had always regarded Lu Yuan as a slave who could come at a moment's notice.
Of course I went.
Lu Yuan was also a little curious.
Shangdao Cafe is located on a pedestrian street called Guanggu Pedestrian Street outside Jinling University. This pedestrian street is quite high-end, and the clothing brands are generally priced at more than 1,000 yuan.
"This way!"
As soon as Lu Yuan entered the coffee shop, Bai Ran waved to him.
It seemed that Bai Ran had arrived a long time ago and was sitting next to a green plant in the cafe.
Bai Ran is dressed very beautifully today, with a white skirt, foam shoes, air bangs, long and shiny hair, accessories on her white jade-like wrists, and she is drinking coffee.
"Are you alone? Didn't Feng Ling come?"
Lu Yuan was very curious. Bai Ran was alone and made an appointment with him in a coffee shop. What was going on?
"I'm telling you, Lu Yuan, don't bother with Feng Ling!" Bai Ran seemed annoyed, "Why, last time you saw Feng Ling bandaging your wounds, did you think she was interested in you? Stop wishful thinking. Feng Ling has a kind personality and treats everyone like this. Besides, are you worthy of her? Can you be a little self-aware?"
"Okay."
Lu Yuan didn't argue with her.
The waiter came over: "Sir, what do you want to order?"
"Here, is there a menu?" Lu Yuangang asked.
Bai Ran sneered at the waiter and said, "It's useless to ask him. He has never been to a place like this. Just give him a cup of coconut-flavored coffee."
To be honest, Lu Yuan was used to Bai Ran's attitude. After all, Bai Ran had always looked down on him in the tennis club.
Therefore, Lu Yuan didn't care much about Bai Ran's attitude.
However, I feel more and more strange in my heart, what exactly does Bai Ran want to find me?
Bai Ran obviously had no intention of telling Lu Yuan in a hurry.
